capabilities: increase heading levels by one with a hotkey
decrease heading levels by one with a hotkey
toggle text between normal text and H1 through H6
extras: README documents limitations: nested headings are not supported, and list items and quotes are treated as normal text.
problem: Changing a heading level requires manually typing or deleting # characters, and Obsidian has no built-in commands for it.
summary: Command-based plugin that increases, decreases, or toggles Markdown heading levels via configurable hotkeys.
